Collect C-index metrics from a train/test MAE pair

Source: R/visualizations.R
benchmark_models.Rd

Traverses @metadata$analysis of both MAE objects and assembles a tidy data frame with one row per (model, integration, dataset) combination. Handles all five integration branches (single-omics, early, late, joint, flexynesis) and the extra beta_rho_* nesting of AFTCoop.

Usage

benchmark_models(
  mae_train,
  mae_test,
  aftcoop_rho = NULL,
  keep_datasets = NULL,
  keep_integrations = NULL
)

Arguments

mae_train

MAE object for the training split.

mae_test

MAE object for the test split.

aftcoop_rho

Numeric scalar selecting which AFTCoop beta_rho variant to keep (e.g. 0.5). Must match one of the keys stored as beta_rho_<value> in metrics. If NULL (default) all three variants are returned as separate rows.

keep_datasets

Character vector of dataset values to retain (e.g. "mRNA", c("mRNA", "early_integrated"), "multiomics"). NULL (default) keeps all datasets. Matched against the dataset column of the output, which mirrors the keys used in @metadata$analysis.

keep_integrations

Character vector of integration types to retain (e.g. "single", c("single", "early")). NULL (default) keeps all. Matched against the integration column ("single", "early", "late", "joint", "flexynesis").

Value

A data.frame with columns model, integration, dataset, harrell_train, harrell_test, uno_test, n_features. n_features is populated for single-omics and early-integration rows; it is NA for late, joint and flexynesis rows. Other missing values are also NA.
